name: 37338-coldprefill-9b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B. bf16 on the hub, 19.3 GB of safetensors, ungated.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine.
architecture: Hybrid decoder (Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration, `qwen3_5`), 32 layers: 24 gated-delta-net linear-attention and 8 full-attention, one full-attention layer every fourth. Dense MLP, no experts. Carries a vision tower, which is not loaded. Everything else is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, bounded at 128 requests with a 1800 s safety cap. No warmup and no cooldown: every request is measured, and the run must be issued against a freshly launched engine process.
workload: Synthetic text, one turn, exactly 8000 prompt tokens and exactly 1 output token on every request (min = max on both axes, so there is no length distribution). `request_format: plain`, i.e. a `/v1/completions` client with no chat template. `temperature: 0.0`, `ignore_eos: true`. Static seed 37338. Prompts are independent and share no prefix.
purpose: A document analysis service on one H100, where a 9B model reads 8000-token documents for eight concurrent users.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Nothing here is tuned.
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B
tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
data-parallel-size: 1
language-model-only: true
safetensors-load-strategy: prefetch

# Pins which linear-attention prefill implementation is served. The default `auto` selects on
# device capability, so leaving this unset makes the served path depend on the GPU.
gdn-prefill-backend: triton

dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 8192
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# Pinned rather than left to a default, and do not drop them: these are what `vllm serve` picks
# on a >=70 GiB non-A100 card at this commit. A programmatically constructed engine falls instead
# to the scheduler floors of 2048 and 128, which would chunk every 8000-token prompt four ways.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

enable-prefix-caching: false
